say:2:1430312101:1.text: It is best to let those disobedient servants experience some punishment for themselves so that they can have a deeper understanding of what is allowed in Sal'thorin.
say:2:1430312101:1.source_cn: 最好让那些不听话的仆从亲身体验一下，这样才够深刻！

say:3:1430312102:1.text: But if a servant dies, I won't have my needs met.
say:3:1430312102:1.source_cn: 可是万一仆从死了，不就没有仆从服侍我了？

say:4:1430312103:1.text: Look at the countless commoners looking to enter the royal city. You have no need to worry.
say:4:1430312103:1.source_cn: 没有仆从？看看那些数不尽的平民，你为什么会有这样的担心？
